description:
Lumi, an apprentice perfumer determined to master the art of fragrance, is attacked by a mysterious black mist while returning home. In the midst of the danger, she is guided by a black cat claiming to be a messenger from the Flower Planet. Following its guidance, she awakens the power of an antique Flower Key left behind by her ancestors and transforms into a Flower Fairy.
The Seven-Colored Flower has withered after being corrupted by dark magic, causing its seven petals to scatter throughout Flower Town. As a result, strange phenomena begin occurring everywhere, gradually consuming the hearts and minds of the townspeople. As a descendant who has inherited the bloodline of the Flower Fairies, Lumi must take on the mission of purifying and collecting the seven petals. Using the magic of floral fragrances, she dispels the darkness in people`s hearts and embarks on a magical girl`s journey of growth.
However, during her adventure, Lumi finds herself under attack from another mysterious Flower Fairy. Even more surprising, the black cat by her side is hiding an unexpected identity of its own...
Source: Tencent, translated

titles.title: Hua Xianzi: Mofa Xiang Dui Lun
